S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools.
S1.notes: Retail: wrong variant selection from product catalog (wrong item_id chosen when multiple options exist). Airline: wrong flight selected from search results, e.g. cheapest vs second cheapest, or wrong destination.

S2.label: Tool calling precision
S2.notes: Most common failure class. Wrong flight number, wrong date, wrong item_id, wrong payment_id, wrong passenger details, payment amount mismatch. Particularly prevalent in airline flight update/booking tasks.

S3.label: Multi-step task completion
S3.notes: Second most common. Retail: modifies only one order when multiple need updating, returns only subset of items, cancels entire order instead of specific items, fails to complete all sub-tasks in one conversation. Airline: updates only one of several reservations, drops sub-tasks.

S4.label: Precondition verification
S4.notes: Airline: issues certificates without checking whether compensation is warranted, cancels non-cancellable reservations, acts on emotional user requests without policy check. Retail: uses wrong payment method, tries to exchange before delivery, tries to modify processed/delivered orders, updates address without verifying order state.

S5.label: Numerical reasoning
S5.notes: Airline: wrong certificate amounts, payment total miscalculations (insurance, certificate stacking). Retail: wrong refund calculation communicated or wrong cheapest-item price comparison.

S6.label: Record discovery and retrieval
S6.notes: Retail: targets wrong order among user's multiple orders, fails to find all relevant orders, fails to verify user identity (missing last name), retrieves wrong reservation. Airline: retrieves wrong reservation for delayed flight, uses wrong reservation in multi-reservation scenarios.

S7.label: Information communication
S7.description: Right action, fails to state values.
S7.notes: Rare. A11: downgrade performed correctly but communicated wrong refund amount. R24: correctly retrieved t-shirt details but stated wrong material. R45: exchange done but communicated wrong price difference.

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then or wrong API for state.
S8.notes: Retail: uses exchange API on non-delivered orders instead of modify, cancels order instead of modifying items, transfers when not needed, doesn't respect order-state-dependent API. Airline: tries to modify basic economy tickets, ignores flight-status-conditional compensation rules.
